title: Verifying an Alien Dictionary
description: Check if words are sorted based on a custom alien alphabet order.
pseudocode:
1. Create mapping from char to index using order
2. Iterate through pairs of adjacent words
3. Compare characters of current pair until mismatch or end of word
4. If mismatch, check if order index of word1[k] > word2[k], return false
5. If loop completes, return true

steps.note: Creating mapping from character to its rank in the alien alphabet.
Comparing first characters: 'h' vs 'l'. Rank of 'h' is 0, rank of 'l' is 1.
0 < 1, so 'hello' comes before 'leetcode'. Words are sorted.
